qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between M8 hex screws and M8 Torx bolts for transmission mounting?
qa_pairs.answer: M8 hex screws use 25 Nm while M8 Torx bolts use 22 Nm, a difference of 3 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection covers these manual transmission torque specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 23-1 Manual Transmission, subsection 23 00 Transmission in general
